breaking_news.headline: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
breaking_news.summary: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

breaking_news.headline: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
breaking_news.summary: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

breaking_news.headline: It's taking longer to find a new job after losing one
breaking_news.summary: People who lose their jobs in this economy are taking longer to find new work. Nearly four in ten people exhaust their unemployment benefits before they land a new job.

breaking_news.headline: Justice Department investigates TV networks, citing possible anti-trust violations
breaking_news.summary: The move escalates Trump's fight with the press amid court battle over barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.

breaking_news.headline: How personal data is being used to control what customers see and pay
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Joel Rose speaks with Lindsay Owens, president of the economic think tank Groundwork Collaborative, about how companies using data to transform the products and prices customers see.

breaking_news.headline: 2 Americans win Nobel Prize in economics for work on boom-bust cycles
breaking_news.summary: Two Americans have won the Nobel Prize in economics for their work on how to smooth boom-and-bust cycles to limit unemployment and inflation.

breaking_news.headline: Farmers say they'll take the relief of Trump's EO — but they're still hurting
breaking_news.summary: President Trump says his Monday executive order temporarily suspending federal taxes on diesel will be a big relief for farmers. Some farmers call it a campaign ploy with marginal impact.

breaking_news.headline: What ice cream has to do with this year's Nobel Prize in economics
breaking_news.summary: Prices can get sticky. That helps explain why recessions hurt so much — and what policymakers can do about them.

breaking_news.headline: Russian strikes hit key power plant in Kyiv, Zelensky says
breaking_news.summary: The Ukrainian president says the ballistic missile strikes came with "no early warning from our partners".

breaking_news.headline: Trump ousts Kimberly Guilfoyle as US ambassador to Greece after corruption allegations
breaking_news.summary: Guilfoyle said the allegations of improper conduct were false and that being ambassador was the "honour of a lifetime".

breaking_news.headline: Missiles intercepted near Riyadh after Saudi coalition hits Yemen fuel depot
breaking_news.summary: The Saudi-led coalition fighting in Yemen struck a fuel depot near the Houthi-controlled capital, Sanaa.

breaking_news.headline: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
breaking_news.summary: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".

breaking_news.headline: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
breaking_news.summary: Four years after the attacks, Serhii K will appear in court accused of a plot to destroy Russia's gas pipelines to Germany.

breaking_news.headline: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
breaking_news.summary: Pope Leo had successful surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican said.

breaking_news.headline: Three things we've learnt about the UK economy from the IMF
breaking_news.summary: The influential economics body has upgraded its UK growth forecast for this year, but risks remain.

breaking_news.headline: Saudi man charged with planting 'sophisticated' recording device in OpenAI office
breaking_news.summary: Prosecutors say the device, wrapped in toilet paper, was found inserted in a USB port on the back of a TV in an executive conference room.

breaking_news.headline: How long will humans be needed for translation?
breaking_news.summary: AI dominates the translation business, but for high-stakes work, humans are still needed.

breaking_news.headline: Bumble bought for $1.3bn in 'bet on the future of humanity'
breaking_news.summary: The dating app which recently ditched its "women-first" chat rule has been bought by an investment firm.

breaking_news.headline: Bank of America hit with $1.2bn fine for money laundering failings
breaking_news.summary: The bank inadequately flagged transactions linked to potential Chinese money laundering networks, the Treasury said.

breaking_news.headline: Is it OK for jobseekers or employers to use AI?
breaking_news.summary: Graduates are increasingly using AI to misrepresent themselves in job applications, research suggests. But some say their peer group has no choice.
